description: The agent must: (1) Run `python scripts/learner_assessment.py --age 32 --skill coding --context work` and parse the JSON output (developmental stage 'Early Adulthood (26-64)', recommended approach 'Efficiency-first with deliberate practice', motivation type 'Extrinsic (career advancement)'). (2) Run `python scripts/bias_detector.py --copy company_data/marketing/signup_funnel_copy_v3.txt` and parse the JSON output which will flag 7 issues (guaranteed, limited time, everyone is, you must, don't miss out, risk-free, instantly) and return 'NEEDS_REVIEW'. (3) Produce `dual_plan.md` that follows BOTH exact output templates from SKILL.md: the Learning Plan template (with ### Learner Profile, ### Goals & Milestones as a Week/Goal/Success Indicator table, ### Method Mix, ### Motivation & Habit Support, ### Risks & Mitigations) AND the Marketing/Conversion Plan template (with ### Audience Profile, ### Psychological Levers (Ethical) table, ### Messaging Hierarchy numbered list with Primary Promise/Proof Point/Differentiator/Risk Reducer, ### Experiment Design, ### Ethical Validation with ☐ checkbox format). The agent must incorporate the learner_assessment.py output into the learner profile section and the bias_detector.py findings (flagged phrases, NEEDS_REVIEW status) into the conversion plan. An agent using only general psychology knowledge without running the scripts and without following the exact SKILL.md template structure (especially the ☐ checkbox Ethical Validation and Goals table format) will fail the proprietary trap checks.
